limitations: Timings cover the marked in-process Python calls; Flask authentication, network transfer, and browser rendering are separate.
Cross-stage WordNet comparisons run inside the relevant Rule Base timing and do not have a separate duration measurement.
The rule trace is built from existing stage outputs and emitted events; it does not rerun the Rule Base or spaCy.

analysis_service_initialization.note: Model/service construction is timed only when Flask creates the service lazily; injected preconstructed services are not timed here.

runtime.note: Metadata is read from the already-loaded NLPService. This function does not parse text or query WordNet.

active_component_output_use.attribute_ruler: Runs in the pipeline; its attributes are available to later components but not separately reported by EssayScaff.
active_component_output_use.lemmatizer: Token lemmas feed topic normalization and concept comparison.
active_component_output_use.ner: Runs in the pipeline; named entities are not consumed by the active EssayScaff analysis output.
active_component_output_use.parser: Dependency labels, heads, sentence boundaries, noun chunks, and subjects/complements feed the services.
active_component_output_use.tagger: Token fine-grained tags are serialized; POS/tag values feed rule conditions.
active_component_output_use.tok2vec: Runs as part of the configured pipeline; EssayScaff does not directly read its vectors.

pipeline.component_timings: not instrumented individually; the recorded parse_ms measures the complete nlp(text) call.

Current Goal.selected_message: Return to your main idea, connect it with earlier points, and leave the reader with one clear ending thought.

Needs Attention.selection_condition: Each caution is appended when its corresponding existing stage result meets the negative/limitation condition.

Next Step.limitation: Rule links describe the selected Next Step condition, not necessarily the Primary Feedback condition.
Next Step.selected_message: Read the Conclusion with the earlier sections. Does it bring the points you chose together?
Next Step.selection_condition: synthesis candidates exist after earlier branches do not apply

Primary Feedback.selected_message: One sentence combines ideas from more than one earlier section. Read it with those sections and check that it brings the ideas together as you intend.

What's Working.selection_condition: Each item is appended when its existing lexical, continuity, synthesis, closure, or phrase-combination condition is met.

feedback_decisions.selection_source: Branch labels and rule IDs follow the recorded evidence checks; student-facing messages use separate plain-language wording.
feedback_decisions.unselected_alternatives: FeedbackService does not record unselected candidate messages or a hidden ranking.
